description: Check products against Google Merchant Center feed rules: missing or invalid GTIN barcodes, long, promotional or all-capital titles, missing descriptions, links, images and brand. Use it for "what would Merchant Center reject?". Pass csv (a Shopify product CSV) or domain (a store address), not both. Returns a summary (products, no_gtin, bad_gtin, long_title, no_description) and up to 200 issues, one per product and rule, with detail. Domain mode reads the store's public product feed once after its robots.txt; a store that blocks it needs a CSV. The public feed has no barcodes, so in domain mode no_gtin and bad_gtin are null and GTINs are not checked; use a CSV for that. Nothing is stored: the file or feed is used for this answer and dropped.

csv.description: The product CSV text exactly as exported from Shopify, header row included. At most 2 MB.

domain.description: A store address such as example.com, instead of csv. The store's public /products.json is read once (at most 5 pages of 250 products), after its robots.txt. Large stores often block it.

name: merchant_feed_check

feed_truncated.description: True when the store has more products than the five pages read

host.description: The store read, in domain mode

notes.description: Checks that could not be made, and why

summary.description: no_gtin and bad_gtin are null when the source has no barcodes to check.

truncated.description: True when there were more than 200 issues

title: Check products for Merchant Center rules
